_why: NIGHT53 I7 (NIGHT53.md section 2; RESEARCH A-5 / A-8; DECIDE53 D-2): each NIGHT52-rebuilt room's opening, one of vista (a look over the arena from a one-way entrance), ambushed (the enemies come at you past a midfield line), ambusher (you come on them unseen), held (ground the enemies hold that you take). A sidecar beside the plans, not a plan field: builder K edits the kiln / span / foundry plans in place tonight, and a field in every room row would collide with K's edits at every pick. Read from each room's identity card in docs/ROOMS.md (the lead, P0); a room's change that changes its opening updates this file in the same commit.
